card.name: Verbs of invitation after a group
card.fires_on: The verb or noun right after a subject like "All", "Any questions" or "you", where the next word is likely "welcome", "invited" or "free to". It sits in open-invitation sentences on event, class and web pages.

modes.label: Are after a group
modes.description: The word "are" or "is" after a group of people who are being invited or encouraged.
modes.example: All<< are>> invited to the event, which is sponsored

modes.label: Polite invitation phrase
modes.description: Words such as "feel" in "Please feel free" that lead into an invitation to join or act.
modes.example: Please<< feel>> free to join our blog, submit a

modes.label: Feedback welcome
modes.description: A noun like "corrections" or "questions" after "Any", before "are welcome".
modes.example: Any<< corrections>> or questions are welcome! also see:

card.writes: It pushes the next word toward "welcome" in several languages.
card.plain: It fires when a sentence is inviting people to join in, just before the word "welcome" or "invited" is likely.
